title: AVOID!!!!!
date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 5 April 2026
review: Absolutely awful, I am convinced this is a fake. I had been searching for a moisturiser that would be safe for my skin as I have MCAS, being as this one was labelled ‘allergy UK approved’ I decided this would be fine. I couldn’t have been more wrong. The instant I put this on my face the stinging started, my eyes started watering, and my nose running. The smell was disgusting, like deep heat spray, not how I imagine a moisturising cream should smell. It also came unsealed; another factor as to why I believe this is a fake. About 5 minutes after application I just couldn’t take the stinging and burning and washed it off, I then broke out in extremely painful hives all on my cheeks and down my neck. AVOID this if you have allergies! It is not allergy safe!

The ingredients aren't great either they're okay but not enough of the good stuff to give my skin any glow/ good results. I also go through this far too fast for the price.  I ended up switching back to a product that gives me that glow, and I can see results with for half the price and it contains way better ingredients. I don't know if my expectations were too high because I've heard such great things. But I'm very disappointed with what I paid and the results I got. Now I have to work hard to get the hydration back in my skin because this fell flat for me. I used this for 3 months for context. Going back to Marcelle for those ladies wondering.

title: Ineffective, overpriced, overhyped
review: I bought this on the recommendation of many people online who said it was good for sensitive skin. I developed spots of psoriasis on my face and reluctantly bought the expensive combo of this moisturizer with the Toleraine facial cleanser and I can confidently say this moisturizer is garbage. I have to use two large pea sized drops to cover my whole face and it's dried out within an hour. A few hours later and my psoriasis is flaking. For comparison, Aveeno Eczema Care lasts all day and I never get any dryness or flaking with it. This tiny tube cost 30 bucks and works worse than stuff you can buy for under $10. If people on Reddit or other social media convinced you to buy this overpriced crap, do yourself a favour and buy something else instead.

title: Pelle migliorata dopo una settimana di utilizzo
review: ✅ I punti di forza• Idratazione duratura (fino a 48 h): grazie alla presenza di glicerina, la crema trattiene efficacemente l’acqua nella pelle, mantenendola morbida e idratata a lungo.  ￼• Azione lenitiva e protettiva: la formula contiene ceramidi e acqua termale di La Roche-Posay, noti per calmare irritazioni, rossori e sensazioni di “pelle che tira”, aiutando a ripristinare e rafforzare la barriera cutanea.  ￼• Adatta a pelli sensibili e reattive: è senza profumo, senza alcol, non comedogena, con tollerabilità dermatologica elevata — anche testata su bambini e neonati.  ￼• Texture leggera e confortevole: si assorbe rapidamente e lascia la pelle morbida, liscia e protetta senza ungere — ottima anche come base quotidiana prima del trucco o da usare mattina e sera.  ￼⚠️ Possibili limiti o aspetti da considerare• Se la tua pelle è molto secca o in inverno con clima freddo, la versione “Sensitive Creme” potrebbe risultare un po’ leggera e potresti desiderare una crema ancora più ricca.• La protezione contro sole, inquinamento o fattori esterni aggressivi è minima — serve sempre un’adeguata protezione solare durante il giorno se esci.• Alcune formule delicate come questa potrebbero non bastare per pelli con problematiche molto specifiche (es. couperose, dermatite severa) senza un supporto aggiuntivo (sieri, trattamenti più intensi).📍 Impressione complessivaLa Roche-Posay Toleriane Sensitive è una crema viso che fa bene ciò che promette: idrata, lenisce, protegge e comforta la pelle sensibile o reattiva. È ideale come crema quotidiana per chi cerca un prodotto semplice, efficace e sicuro — particolarmente se la pelle tende a irritarsi, tirare o arrossarsi. Se vuoi una cura delicata e affidabile per viso e collo, senza fragranze o ingredienti aggressivi: questa crema è una scelta azzeccata.
